headline: The four-card case is reachable because the customer's scripted answers steer each card, but the rule for a single 3-point risk flag never says whether to unlock, transfer, or replace.

issues.summary: The Green card scores only 5 (MEDIUM, unlockable after the customer confirms), but B3=3 triggers "escalate to supervisor review". Gold reads that as closing and replacing the card with reason fraud_suspected even though the customer confirmed the attempts. The closure reason survives the verified scorer through the new card's issue_reason.
evidence: db bank_account_transaction_history: Green declines at 11:42:15, 11:42:32, 11:42:51 (17s/19s gaps -> B3 = 3); Blue has fraud_alert_active=true (D3 +2); total 5
doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_041: "If ANY single flag equals 3 points, escalate to supervisor review regardless of total score." and "5-7 | MEDIUM | Unlock only after asking..."
user instruction 21: "If agent offers to close and replace OR transfer to security: Fine, I'll take a new card then."
gold[13] close_debit_card_4721 dbc_rw42b8d3e1_green reason "fraud_suspected"; gold[14] order STANDARD/CLASSIC
tools.py order_debit_card_5739: issue_reason = closure_reason if closure_reason != "fraud_suspected" else "fraud"; other reasons -> "first_card"
replay: Green closed with "no_longer_needed" or "damaged" -> verified match False (debit_cards differs); Green reset instead of close -> False
issues.why_it_matters: The simulator steers to close-and-replace whenever closure or transfer is offered. Two divergences remain: an agent that transfers immediately ends the call before cards 3-4, and an agent that picks a non-fraud closure reason for a customer who confirmed the attempts writes issue_reason "first_card".
issues.suggested_fix: Spell out in doc_041 what "supervisor review" means for a chat agent (for example, "cannot unlock; offer closure/replacement with reason fraud_suspected").

issues.summary: The Evergreen card is LOW/MEDIUM and should be unlocked, but no unlock tool exists and no document says a PIN reset unlocks. Gold uses reset_debit_card_pin_6284.
evidence: tools.py reset_debit_card_pin_6284 docstring: "Reset a debit card PIN when the customer has forgotten it." (the code also sets pin_locked=False, but only the tool output after the call says "Your card has been unlocked")
doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_027 PIN Reset/PIN Change steps never mention unlocking a locked card

doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_041 STEP 3: "0-4 | LOW | Unlock after standard identity verification"; no unlock tool exists in tools.py (no discoverable method other than reset_debit_card_pin_6284 clears pin_locked)
replay: change_debit_card_pin_6285 instead -> verified match False (reset tool name missing; debit_cards differs)
issues.why_it_matters: An agent that does not infer reset-as-unlock leaves pin_locked=True or uses change-PIN, and fails.
issues.suggested_fix: Document in doc_041/027 that reset_debit_card_pin_6284 clears the PIN lock.

solution_check: Blue: Tijuana MX at 3 AM (A1 3, B1 3, C1 2, C2 1, C3 2, C4 2, A3 1, B3 1-2, about 16), the customer was asleep, so close fraud_suspected and order Mid-tier free STANDARD/CLASSIC, matching gold[8]/[10]. Green: as in issue 1, the gold is reached via the scripted line 21. Evergreen: 4-5 points (B3 1-2, D1 1, D3 2), confirmed, so reset 8127 matches gold[18]. Light Blue has a security_hold, so a transfer is accepted, matching gold[20] (no DB write). The gold matches my reconstruction, given the simulator's steering.
prior_note: The prior Minor (fuzzy thresholds settled by customer answers) still holds; I add that the closure reason affects issue_reason even under the verified scorer.
notes: The A1=3 and B1=3 single-flag escalation on the Blue card is likewise satisfied by close-and-replace plus the final transfer. transfer_to_human_agents writes nothing to the DB. The gold transfer reason "fraud_or_security_concern" is ungraded under DB-only reward_basis.
